title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record, and 1 trade says nothing about a strategy. This note reports the live paper record as it stands at the snapshot read at 2026-11-14T09:06:19.188Z. It does not project. The engines count their live records from different starts: v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The earliest live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. That ATOM position exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, for -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and the market filter

At the snapshot, htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and 6 closed trades so far with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 also has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and 7 closed trades so far with an average -13.34% net per trade. The trend engines also report the names closest to their 20-day breakout: for v005, AVAXUSDT is 8.56% below its high, TRXUSDT is 11.41% below its high, and XLMUSDT is 15.20% below its high; for v006, JUPUSDT is 8.39% below its high, AVAXUSDT is 8.56% below its high, and TRXUSDT is 11.41% below its high. These percentages are distances below the high, not entry signals; a smaller percentage means a market is closer to its 20-day breakout level, while a larger percentage means it is farther away. A market filter that is off is consistent with no trend entries being open at the snapshot, and the record shows that state alongside 0 open positions. The measurement is the state of the filter and the count of open positions; the record does not add a reason beyond those facts. The filter state is reported as off for both trend engines, and the record does not state a trigger for that state.

## Closed trades and the recent ATOM exit

The most recent closed trade in the live paper record is ATOM. It entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703. The recorded result is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That is 1 closed trade, not a strategy verdict. The -17.9% figure is after the 30 bps round trip, so the cost is already inside the reported result. NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since, so it has no closed result in this note and its result is not yet part of the closed-trade averages. Across the trend engines, the closed-trade averages are -13.22% net per trade over 6 trades for v005 and -13.34% net per trade over 7 trades for v006. The testing expectation stated for the approach was an average winner of roughly +19%, with losses more common than wins, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. Those testing figures describe prior testing, not the live record, and they do not predict the next trade.

## What the record does not establish

Every position here is paper, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. 1 closed trade, including the ATOM result at -17.9%, says nothing about a strategy. The htf-rsi-v007 record shows 4 closed trades with an average null net per trade; that is a reported average, not a settled performance verdict, and the average is not converted into a percentage in this note. The trend-engine averages of -13.22% over 6 trades and -13.34% over 7 trades are net per trade as reported; they are not annualized or adjusted here. They are also small samples in a live paper record that started on 1 October 2026 for v005 and 9 October 2026 for v006. The snapshot read at 2026-11-14T09:06:19.188Z is 1 point in time. It does not show future entries, future exits, or future filter states. It also does not show whether NEAR will close above or below its entry at 5.896, and this note does not make that call.

## Where the same numbers appear

The record is continuous. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status are the places named in the record for checking these figures. The snapshot used here was read at 2026-11-14T09:06:19.188Z. Readers checking those places should see the same open-position counts, closed-trade counts, averages, filter states, and distances from 20-day breakouts that are reported above. If a later snapshot differs, that difference is the record updating, not a contradiction.
